A Gem of a Restaurant in Da Nang
Feb 2019 • Solo
Mai Boutique Villa Restaurant and Bar is one of the top two restaurants Ive been to in Vietnam. For months I had dinner at other restaurants in Da Nang,
but I was always looking for and trying new restaurants. Then, I tried the restaurant at Mai Boutique Villa, and I never ate anywhere else for dinner.

 Lien Mai and Michiel, a Vietnamese and Dutch couple have a fine eatery with high quality food that is both delicious and nourishing. Whether you like high quality Australian beef, or local seafood, their restaurant has a broad selection of Vietnamese and Western cuisines.

 As a vegetarian, there is plenty of good options for me. I find their Mornings Glory (a green vegetable grown locally for those who do not know) to be positively addictive. And, I love the Greek salad. I eat those two regularly and never get tired of them. 

 The pizza at Mai Boutique Villa Restaurant and Bar is one of the best 
I've ever had and in my life, I've had plenty of good ones. And, the waitresses and Lien Mai make great smoothies. I'd recommend the banana, and I love the Mango too, and the Passion fruit. 

 When I leave Vietnam eating at their restaurant is one of the things I will miss.
But, I'll be back. The wooden tables in the restaurant are very nice, and the atmosphere is laid back, and it is a pleasure to eat there. I highly recommend it.

Dinner at Mai Boutique
Dec 2017 • Couples
We dropped in for dinner as we were staying nearby. I ordered the tenderloin listed on the specials board. They came back to inform me it wasn’t available so I ordered the beef salad. It was okay but for my taste could use a bit more spice. The spring rolls were good. My husband asked if the cobra was fresh. He was told it came in today. It was presented as multiple pieces of fish with fresh orange on the side. It did not taste very fresh to either of us after we each had a bite. The server offered a 10% discount to compensate for the fish. Service was very kind. There was quite a lot of noise from a musical party upstairs.
